verdict.rationale: Asking whether customer data is used to train AI models is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, a data-usage opt-out, or any related privacy control. The items cover invoicing, payments, the API, webhooks and pricing, none of which is about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
